# Cully v0.4.0

Local and team self-hosted setup no longer needs Python on the host. The Go CLI now generates and reuses the private database passwords, service tokens and single-user owner. Existing `~/.cully/config.json` credentials are preserved across upgrades; Mem0 still runs its Python components inside Docker.

- Cully's session hooks and skill help connected agents retrieve relevant notes and save concise task handoffs with `cully_log`. Hooks do not upload full transcripts or write notes on their own.
- `cully_context` gives bounded previews, while Mem0 supports semantic recall backed by source notes in PostgreSQL. The local advisor offers separate session suggestions for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
- The CLI installer uses agent-specific binary locations and updates the matching shell PATH entry when possible.
- The docs now start with a task-based quickstart and link to detailed memory, advisor, session optimization and deployment guides.

Install the new release before running `cully setup`. The [quickstart](https://docs.cully.net/quickstart) covers the laptop path; [OAuth setup](https://docs.cully.net/oauth) covers optional team sign-in.
